description:
Lexly is a study app built around the BC Grade 12 curriculum. Pre-Calculus 11 and 12, Anatomy & Physiology 12, and AP Biology 12 are written to the provincial course outlines, so what you drill is what's actually on the exam.

Each course is a unit-by-unit tree rather than a scroll of cards. You work a unit, the app tracks what you got wrong, and spaced repetition brings those questions back right before you'd forget them. The Masterclass reader holds the long-form material — full course notes you read straight through when drilling isn't the point.

Around the Grade 12 core there's supporting material for the subjects those courses lean on: math from arithmetic through linear algebra, physics, chemistry, biology, anatomy and physiology. Twelve languages with speech practice, plus programming, music theory and chess, round out the library once your coursework is done.

Everything works offline. No subscription, no ads. Sign in only if you want progress on more than one device.
keywords: bc curriculum,pre-calculus 12,ap biology 12,anatomy physiology 12,grade 12 study,course notes
whatsNew: The BC Grade 12 courses now open the catalog instead of sitting behind the language packs. Four new science courses back them up: Astrophysics, Anthropology, Anatomy, and Physiology. Checking an answer gives a small haptic tap, so you can feel right and wrong without watching the screen.
